metadata.subject: Physics
metadata.topic: Optics — Properties of a Plane Mirror Image
metadata.note: 4 properties of a plane mirror image: virtual, same size as object, laterally inverted, same distance behind the mirror as object is in front. 4 slots × 1m each = 4m. Word bank: 8 tokens (4 correct + 4 distractors).

question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2022 Q3b — Properties of a Plane Mirror Image
question.text:
State FOUR properties of the image formed by a plane mirror by selecting the correct property for each numbered blank:

Property 1: [[1]]

Property 2: [[2]]

Property 3: [[3]]

Property 4: [[4]]
question.general_feedback:
Properties of a plane mirror image:

  1. Virtual — the image cannot be formed on a screen; it appears to be behind the mirror
  2. Same size as the object — the image is the same height and width as the object (magnification = 1)
  3. Laterally inverted — left and right are swapped (e.g. text appears reversed)
  4. Same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front — image distance = object distance (measured perpendicularly to the mirror)

Summary: VSLE — Virtual, Same size, Laterally inverted, Equal distance

Real (can be projected on a screen)
Same size as the object
Magnified (larger than the object)

Upright and the same way up as the object (not inverted)
Same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front

groups.label: Property 1 of a plane mirror image
groups.diagnostic_hint: A plane mirror image is VIRTUAL — it cannot be formed on a screen because the light rays do not actually converge behind the mirror; they only appear to diverge from that point.

groups.label: Property 2 of a plane mirror image
groups.diagnostic_hint: The image is the SAME SIZE as the object (magnification = 1). The mirror does not enlarge or shrink the object.

groups.label: Property 3 of a plane mirror image
groups.diagnostic_hint: The image is LATERALLY INVERTED — left and right are swapped. For example, your right hand appears as a left hand in a mirror.

ddwtos.word_bank_note: 8 tokens for 4 slots; 5 correct properties + 3 wrong. The 5 correct properties are: Virtual, Same size, Laterally inverted, Upright, and Same distance. Students must pick any 4 of the 5 — all 5 are marked correct=true and any valid combination of 4 earns 4m. Wrong tokens: Real (converging lens images are real, not plane mirror), Magnified (curved/concave mirrors may magnify), Inverted (plane mirror images are NOT inverted top-to-bottom, though they ARE laterally inverted). This is a classic CSEC question where knowing 'virtual' vs 'real' is tested.
